snippet.title: Ultimate Chicken Horse - Mobile Launch Trailer (Out Now!)
snippet.description:
Download Now! 
App Store- https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ultimate-chicken-horse/id6737635326
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.noodlecake.UltimateChickenHorse

Developed by Clever Endeavour
Published by Noodlecake

NOTICE – TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
Play the beginning for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No ads.

Ultimate Chicken Horse, the chaotic party platformer where you build the level as you play has finally made its way to mobile!

🐔 Key Features 🐴
Cross-platform multiplayer: Play with friends on mobile, console, or PC—up to 4 players!

Build-as-you-go chaos: Drop traps, projectiles, and platforms to outsmart (or sabotage) your pals.

21 wild levels: Each with unique features and challenges.​

Custom level builder: Craft your own courses and race for top times in Challenge Mode.

Rule your way: Tweak game modes and rules to keep things fresh—or totally unhinged.

Adorable chaos crew: Choose from a lovable lineup of animals like Chicken, Horse, Sheep, Raccoon, and more.

Let the party begin—on the go! 

Hit that Subscribe button for more game trailers, updates, and behind-the-scenes from Noodlecake!
